# Open Wind interface headers

Public sampling, renderer, and UI contracts supplied by Open Wind.
Only interface/data headers are vendored here; the Open Wind implementation
and optional integration DLLs are built and distributed separately.

Source: [Open Wind](https://github.com/kevdevrev/open-wind), commit
`dd035efb68ca424a8323e6ee8157db3820219392`.
License: GPL-3.0-only; see the repository COPYING.
